senses.gloss:
1. उष् cl. 1. P. (connected with 3. वस्, q.v.) ओषति, ओषां-चकार, and उवोष (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 38; 3. pl. ऊषुः, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 78), ओषिता, ओषिष्यति, औषीत्, Dhātup. xvii, 45 : cl. 9. P. (p. उष्ण॑त्, RV. ii, 4, 7)
to burn, burn down (active), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Mn. iv, 189; Śiś.;
to punish, chastise, Mn. ix, 273 :
Pass. उष्यते, ओषां-चक्रे, to burn (neuter), Suśr.; Car.; Bhaṭṭ.
2. उ॑ष् f. (only अ॑स् gen. sg.) early morning, dawn, RV.; AV. xvi, 6, 6
pl. (उष॑स् तिस्रः॑ morning, midday, and evening, RV. viii, 41, 3.)
ऊष् cl. 1. P. ऊषति, ऊषां-चकार, ऊषिता, &c., to be sick or ill, Dhātup. xvii, 32.
